## Observation
On Windows, `git show <rev>:<path>` run without `--` dies with exit 128 and `fatal: failed to stat '<rev>:<path>': Filename too long` when cwd plus the argument reaches MAX_PATH. Measured in `sweep (windows)` run 44899637411 (2026-11-21 PST) for `fsck_restore`; a shorter temp path passed (run 44899366277), and `git cat-file blob` passed (run 44900309390). cold-censorable-armedcrab fixed `fsck_restore` (4f14a00093f, Gerrit 3511). This ticket covers the rest.

## Sites on origin/main 39d78c81fd5 (`git show <rev>:<path>`, no `--`)
Product, 12 reads:
- src/rebar/_commands/_init_ensures.py:98, :122, :164 (`tickets:.gitattributes`, `tickets:.gitignore`, `tickets:<compat>`)
- src/rebar/_commands/init.py:440 (`tickets:.pre-commit-config.yaml`)
- src/rebar/_commands/reclaim_publish.py:108 (`<rev>:<compat>`)
- src/rebar/_engine_support/bridge_fsck.py:151 (`<tickets ref>:<path>`)
- src/rebar/_opcert_gate_config.py:195 (`<spec>` = `<ref>:<prefix>rebar.toml`/`pyproject.toml`)
- src/rebar/_store/compat.py:180, :274, :296 (`<ref or commit>:<compat>`)
- src/rebar/_store/project_ensures.py:67 (`tickets:<projects.json>`)
- src/rebar/llm/evals/engine_comparison.py:217 (`HEAD:<path>`)

Scripts, 4 reads: scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py:517 (run by `make lint`), scripts/measure_get_rotation_cutover.py:53, :56, scripts/measure_baseline_normalization.py:43.

Several sites treat a non-zero exit as "absent", so a deep Windows path misreads an existing object as missing (the `_init_ensures` units then re-create and commit a file that exists). Others (`bridge_fsck`, `_opcert_gate_config`, `check_complexity_baseline`) fail closed on a healthy store.

## Root cause
For revision-parsing verbs (`show`, `log`, `diff`, `rev-list`) git runs a filename-ambiguity check on every revision argument unless `--` ends the revisions. That check stats `<cwd>\<rev>:<path>`; on Windows the stat fails with ENAMETOOLONG at MAX_PATH and git aborts. `git cat-file blob <rev>:<path>` resolves the object name only and never stats it (run 44900309390). `rev-parse` and `cat-file -e` on a valid name skip the stat too, so their uses are out of class.

## Approach
1. Replace each of the 16 reads with `git cat-file blob <rev>:<path>` through the same wrapper, keeping each site's `check`/`text`/timeout/returncode handling. `cat-file blob` prints the same bytes as `git show` on a blob (neither runs textconv) and exits non-zero for a missing path or ref, so every "absent" branch keeps its meaning. Update comments, docstrings and the `bridge_fsck` `operation=` label that name `show`. No config key, env var or flag.
2. Guard: new `tests/unit/test_rev_path_read_guard.py` AST-scans `src/rebar/**/*.py` and `scripts/**/*.py`. A git call (callee name containing `git`, or argv list literal starting `"git"`) is reported when (a) its verb is `show`/`log`/`diff`/`rev-list`, it has no `--`, and an argument is a `<rev>:<path>` literal, f-string or same-function local bound to one; or (b) its verb is `show` with no `--` and no commit-display flag (`-s`, `--no-patch`, `--stat`, `--name-only`, `--name-status`, `--format…`, `--pretty…`), which catches a path that arrives as a parameter. The message names file:line and the remedy. Synthetic positive and negative cases pin the detector (f-string, literal, local, parameter, `-s --format` read, `cat-file blob`, `rev-parse`, trailing `--`, `add_parser("show")`).
3. Behaviour: new `tests/unit/test_rev_path_reads_long_cwd.py` commits every file the product sites read on a `tickets` branch, adds a `--no-checkout` linked worktree (the shape of `.tickets-tracker`) padded so `len(cwd) + 1 + len(argument) >= 260` while its `.git` file stays under MAX_PATH, and drives each product read through its real function: the 4 ensure units return `ok`, `_commit_precommit` makes no commit, `_record_at`, `_unknown_event_types_from_ref`, `_committed_toml`, the 3 compat readers and `_fixture_files` return the committed content. It runs on every platform; on Windows it reproduces the MAX_PATH condition. A temp dir too long to build the case fails the test with that diagnostic rather than skipping.
4. `tests/scripts/bridge/test_bridge_fsck_binding_drift.py::test_scan_failures_raise_public_rebar_error` keys its fake on `args[0] == "show"`; change it to `cat-file`.

## Scope
src/rebar/_commands/_init_ensures.py, src/rebar/_commands/init.py, src/rebar/_commands/reclaim_publish.py, src/rebar/_engine_support/bridge_fsck.py, src/rebar/_opcert_gate_config.py, src/rebar/_store/compat.py, src/rebar/_store/project_ensures.py, src/rebar/llm/evals/engine_comparison.py, scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py, scripts/measure_get_rotation_cutover.py, scripts/measure_baseline_normalization.py, tests/unit/test_rev_path_read_guard.py (new), tests/unit/test_rev_path_reads_long_cwd.py (new), tests/scripts/bridge/test_bridge_fsck_binding_drift.py. No `.github/windows-sweep-deselect/*.args` line belongs to this bug.

## Testing
- Guard red/green: run it on origin/main (fails, 16 sites) and on the fix (passes).
- Windows, pre-merge: push the fixed tree to `tmp/b5-comic-heavyset-jerboa` and dispatch `test.yml`; push the same tree with only the product and script edits reverted to `tmp/b5-comic-heavyset-jerboa-red` and dispatch. Record both `sweep (windows)` run ids. Delete both branches.
- Windows, post-merge: the first scheduled `test.yml` run on main containing the merge commit.
- `make verify` through verify-slot.sh before the push.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] All 16 reads listed above (12 product, 4 script) use `git cat-file blob`.
- [x] No `git show`/`log`/`diff`/`rev-list` call in `src/rebar` or `scripts` passes a `<rev>:<path>` argument without `--` (the guard test passes on the fix).
- [x] `tests/unit/test_rev_path_read_guard.py` fails on origin/main 39d78c81fd5 (outcome in a comment).
- [x] `tests/unit/test_rev_path_reads_long_cwd.py` fails in the pre-merge `sweep (windows)` run without the product change (run id in a comment).
- [x] `tests/unit/test_rev_path_reads_long_cwd.py` passes in the pre-merge `sweep (windows)` run with the product change (run id in a comment).
- [x] `tests/unit/test_rev_path_reads_long_cwd.py` passes in a `sweep (windows)` run on main after the merge (run id in a comment).
- [x] `make verify` exits 0 on the pushed tree (log path in a comment).
- [x] The change is merged to main at LLM-Review +1, Verified +1 (Gerrit number, merge SHA in a comment).
